description: This file implements a web service class `SugarWebServiceImpl` providing various methods for interacting with the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM backend, including CRUD operations for beans, relationships, user login/logout, and server info. It acts as the main SOAP API endpoint for remote interactions with the CRM system.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements the main SOAP web service for interacting with SuiteCRM/SugarCRM backend, handling CRUD operations, relationships, user sessions, and system info.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a single bean record by ID, acting as a shortcut to get_entries.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches multiple bean records by a list of IDs, including link field data.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bean records with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: set_relationship
methods.description: Creates or deletes a relationship between two beans identified by module and ID.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Creates or deletes multiple relationships for multiple modules and beans.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related beans and relationship data for a specified bean.

methods.name: set_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates a single bean record.

methods.name: set_entries
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple bean records.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user and starts a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Ends the current user session.

methods.name: get_server_info
methods.description: Returns server version, flavor, and current GMT time.

methods.name: get_user_id
methods.description: Returns the current user's ID for a session.

methods.name: get_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves vardef metadata for a module.

methods.name: seamless_login
methods.description: Performs a silent login check for an existing session.

methods.name: set_note_attachment
methods.description: Uploads or updates an attachment on a Note.

methods.name: get_note_attachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment from a Note.

methods.name: set_document_revision
methods.description: Adds a new revision to a Document.

methods.name: get_document_revision
methods.description: Fetches the contents of a document revision.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a full-text search across specified modules.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Lists modules accessible to the logged-in user.

methods.name: set_campaign_merge
methods.description: Records campaign merge activity with target IDs.

methods.name: get_entries_count
methods.description: Counts records matching query criteria.
